comment: Narration for the Writing Task 1 reel. atFrame is the earliest frame a line may start; the builder never starts a line before its beat, and inserts silence to reach it. pauseAfter buys the beat of silence before a reveal. rate scales the engine's speaking rate: >1 is brisker. Lines are deliberately short — a wall-to-wall voice track leaves no room for the reveals to land.

lines.text: Most people write the Task One overview wrong.
U.K. up twenty three. Brazil up fifty!
U.K. highest in both years. India lowest in both.
Overall, access increased in every country, with the sharpest growth in developing economies.
The U.K. and Japan stayed the leaders; India stayed lowest.
